title: 预防工业激光的声响惊吓：参观者安全
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/11_Preventing Industrial Laser Sound Shock Innovative Laser Maintenance Tourist Saf.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/11_Preventing Industrial Laser Sound Shock Innovative Laser Maintenance Tourist Saf/src.py

points.K7: 快排放时，别让人站旁边

shots.scene: 欣欣站在车间门口，双手捂着耳朵又放下
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a workshop door, covers its ears, then lowers its paws and smiles.
shots.narration: 车间里突然一响，访客会吓一跳。
overlay: 预防工业激光的声响惊吓：参观者安全

shots.scene: 储罐、安全阀、白雾、气动台面四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cryogenic tank, a relief valve, a white vapor cloud and a ball transfer table. No people.
shots.narration: 今天看看哪些声音会吓到人。

shots.scene: 办公区门口，几位访客跟着老李准备进车间
shots.prompt_en: At an office door with a blank welcome sign, a few visitors follow the facility engineer toward the workshop.
shots.narration: 老李带几位访客参观激光车间。

shots.scene: 老李推开门，身后是满是机器的车间
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes open a door to a workshop full of machines.
shots.narration: 推开门，就是工业车间了。

shots.scene: 访客们指着远处的激光切割机，满脸好奇
shots.prompt_en: Visitors point curiously at a laser cutting machine in the distance.
shots.narration: 访客来了，都想看看激光。

shots.scene: 家、办公室的图标，和一个满是机器的车间图标对比
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a home and an office next to an icon of a busy industrial workshop. No people.
shots.narration: 他们习惯的是家里和办公室。

shots.scene: 访客东张西望，对车间很陌生
shots.prompt_en: Visitors look around in confusion at the unfamiliar machines and tanks.
shots.narration: 不熟悉工业车间里的情况。

shots.scene: 老李走在访客身旁，伸手示意他们跟紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks beside the visitors and gestures for them to stay close.
shots.narration: 带他们进来，就得照看好他们。

shots.scene: 激光切割机旁，一个压缩空气罐和两个不锈钢低温储罐
shots.prompt_en: Next to a laser cutting machine: a compressed air tank and two stainless steel cryogenic tanks with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 激光切割要用辅助气体。

shots.scene: 压缩空气、液氮、液氧三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: compressed air, liquid nitrogen and liquid oxygen. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩空气，或者液氮、液氧。

shots.scene: 储罐剖面示意：底部是液体，上方是气体，温度计图标很低
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a cryogenic tank: liquid at the bottom, gas above, and a very low thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这些低温液体非常冷。

shots.scene: 温度计图标旁写着零下400度
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with the mercury at the very bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 老李说，低于零下400度。

shots.scene: 外面的热量箭头传入罐内，罐里的压力表指针慢慢上升
shots.prompt_en: Heat arrows flow into the tank from outside and a pressure gauge needle slowly rises. No people.
shots.narration: 吸了热，罐里的压力就不断升高。

shots.scene: 老李手扶液氮储罐顶部，指着一个阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rests a hand on top of a nitrogen tank and points at a valve.
shots.narration: 压力高了，安全阀会排气。

shots.scene: 储罐顶部的安全阀冒出细细的气流
shots.prompt_en: A thin stream of gas hisses out of a relief valve on top of the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 有时能听到嘶嘶的声音。

shots.scene: 安全阀突然弹起，大声排气的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the relief valve suddenly pops open with a loud burst of gas. No people.
shots.narration: 有时还会突然起跳。

shots.scene: 一位访客听到声音缩了一下
shots.prompt_en: A visitor flinches at a sudden hissing sound.
shots.narration: 这声音，会让访客心里发慌。

shots.scene: 老李走到另一台氧气储罐旁，旁边是黄色护栏
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to an oxygen tank next to a yellow safety railing.
shots.narration: 再看这台液氧储罐。

shots.scene: 罐顶阀门附近一圈白霜和水珠
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of white frost and water droplets forming around the valves on top of the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 罐顶这里开始结霜、凝露了。

shots.scene: 结霜图标连到安全阀图标，旁边一个感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A frost icon linked by an arrow to a relief valve icon with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这是压力升高、快要排放的迹象。

shots.scene: 储罐顶部突然喷出一大团白雾，老李就站在旁边
shots.prompt_en: A big white vapor cloud suddenly bursts from the top of the tank while the facility engineer stands right next to it.
shots.narration: 话音刚落，储罐喷出一团白雾。

shots.scene: 白雾慢慢散开，罐顶阀门落回
shots.prompt_en: The white cloud slowly drifts away and the valve on top settles back. No people.
shots.narration: 排放之前，它会先放出气体。

shots.scene: 访客图标被吓得后退，头顶一个惊叹号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visitor jumping back in surprise with an exclamation mark overhead. No people.
shots.narration: 没准备的人，真会被吓一跳。

shots.section_title: 快排放时，别让人站旁边
shots.scene: 老李站在液氧储罐旁对镜头说话
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands beside the oxygen tank and speaks to the camera.
shots.narration: 觉得它快要起跳的时候，
overlay: 快排放时，别让人站旁边

shots.section_title: 快排放时，别让人站旁边
shots.scene: 访客站在储罐旁的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visitor standing right beside a tank, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让访客站在储罐旁边。

shots.scene: 老李走到上料台旁，台面布满万向球格栅
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to a loading table covered with a grid of ball transfer units, next to a sheet metal rack.
shots.narration: 再看这张上料台。

shots.scene: 老李按下侧面控制盒的按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses a button on a control box on the side of the table.
shots.narration: 按下按钮，台面的万向球气动升起。

shots.scene: 万向球一齐升起，伴随一声响
shots.prompt_en: All the transfer balls rise up together with a sudden loud sound. No people.
shots.narration: 这一声，也会让人跳起来。

shots.scene: 一位访客背对着台面，听到响声吓了一跳
shots.prompt_en: A visitor with his back to the table jumps in surprise at the sound.
shots.narration: 背对着、第一次来的人最容易被吓到。

shots.scene: 耳朵图标和一个笑脸访客图标
shots.prompt_en: An ear icon next to a smiling visitor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 别让声音惊吓到你的访客。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现储罐、结霜、白雾、万向球台四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four icons: a cryogenic tank, frost, a vapor cloud and a ball transfer table.
shots.narration: 低温储罐会升压，安全阀会嘶嘶起跳。

shots.scene: 老李带着访客站在离储罐远一点的地方
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer leads the visitors to stand a little farther from the tanks.
shots.narration: 结霜是预兆，别让访客站旁边。

shots.scene: 欣欣和访客们在车间门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the visitors at the workshop door.
shots.narration: 带访客，别让声音吓到人，下次见！
